items.q: The gap at each end of the existing counter — west end to the corner, east end to the door casing.
items.why: Two numbers, and the one thing photographs genuinely cannot give us. The counter's end panel stands 24 inches forward of the wall, so no single photo can separate depth from sideways position — five separate attempts failed today for that reason, not for lack of trying. More pixels won't fix it. A tape will. It's the last assumption holding up the counter's exact position.

items.q: Conceal the wine bay's slider track behind a fascia?
items.why: The track runs exposed for fourteen feet above the run, and the ledger already records a preference for tracks hidden behind a fascia. The Wine Wall lane deliberately did not decide this one — unlike the cove strip, which showed zero visible pixels and was simply dropped, this is a visible change to a run your dad has been reviewing for weeks.
